title: %typeOf — type name of a value
purpose: Return the type name of a value as a string.
notes: Returns one of: null, string, integer, number, currency, boolean, date, timestamp, array, object, and more.
Use it for routing logic when you need the type name rather than a boolean check.

avoid.why: an ISO date supplied as the bare string "2020-01-15" reports "string", not "date", because it arrives untyped. Coerce with %coerceDate first if you expect a date type.
